action.objective: Complete the forcing line: after Qc8+ Kf7, capture the b7 pawn with check (Rxb7+), driving the king and keeping the rook active on the seventh rank.
action.rationale: b1b7 is the only commit_ready move, verified exact -509 at depth 4 with a full mate-safety probe (not_found, no mating reply) and no opponent captures after. The worst alternative e3e4 was proven refuted by g6g2#. Alternative g2g3 and others remain unverified and untested, so I retain the verified rook check as the concrete tactical continuation of the forced Qc8+ Kf7 line.
